svg.aria-label: Makine Çeviri, English to Turkish, one line at a time, with each English word linked to the Turkish word or suffix that carries it. 'Welcome to my world.' becomes 'Dünyama hoş geldin.' (dünya-m-a: world, my, to). 'We translate games into Turkish.' becomes 'Oyunları Türkçeye çeviriyoruz.', the verb last with 'we' as its suffix. '321 contributions in the last year.' becomes 'Son bir yılda 321 katkı.', singular after a number. 'Goodbye, World!' becomes 'Elveda, Dünya!'

text.tspan: Three English words fold into one:
The verb comes last and carries its subject:
After a number the noun stays singular:
